story.summary: Allow agents to approve or edit AI drafts before sending, ensuring only accurate answers reach users. Approve triggers response send and KB update; edits tracked. [Source: 5-3-approve-edit-flow.md]

requirements.requirement: Approve button sends response, updates KB, removes item, auto-loads next.
Edit field allows agent to modify draft; system records diff.
Approve button disabled until >3s review; success toast.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Approve button triggers response send, KB update, dequeue, auto-load next.
Edit field supports draft modification, diff tracking.
Approve button disabled for >3s review, success toast on send.

structure.backend: API for approve/edit, send response, update KB, dequeue, record diff.
structure.frontend: Approve/edit UI, approve button, edit field, diff view, success toast, auto-load next.
